items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The envelope copy on page 2 shows formal service (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) with the delivery day handwritten as '23.11.2026' (Monday) — this is an explicit, documented service date, so the normal 3/4-day deemed-delivery rule for ordinary post does not apply; the actual service day is used instead. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (23.11.) itself is not counted; the two-week period begins the next day. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of weeks ends with the day of the last week bearing the same name as the day of the triggering event, i.e. the second Monday after 23.11.2026, which is 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB). The Einspruch must therefore be received by the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the Gesamtbetrag (fine, fee and service costs) once the decision is final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Payment only becomes due once the Bußgeldbescheid is rechtskräftig (final), which — if no Einspruch is filed — occurs the day after the two-week Einspruch period expires, i.e. the day after 07.12.2026 = 08.12.2026. Starting the count the day after that event (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ending two weeks later on the matching weekday (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) gives 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), a working day in Niedersachsen so no shift is needed. This date is conditional: it only holds if no Einspruch is lodged by 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is filed, the Bescheid does not become final on this schedule and the payment deadline described here does not start.

warnings: The payment due date of 22.12.2026 is conditional on no Einspruch being filed by 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is lodged, the Bescheid does not become rechtskräftig on this schedule and the stated payment trigger does not apply.

The IBAN printed (DE68 2825 0110 0002 6382 00) is well-formed and belongs to 'Landesmusterbank', but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to the Bußgeldstelle — compare it with any earlier correspondence or the city's official website before paying.
The violation (expired Hauptuntersuchung by more than four months) will also be recorded as 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister, which is not a dated obligation but worth noting.
